definitions.explanation: a traditional Japanese celebration held approximately 100 days after a baby's birth, featuring a symbolic first meal ceremony

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{百日|ももか}{祝|いわ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{百日|ももか}{祝|いわ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦スタジオ→スタジオ：11583_sutajio⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{撮|と}った→撮る：00760_toru⟧。
examples.english: We took photos for the 100-day celebration at a studio.

examples.japanese: {百日|ももか}{祝|いわ}い⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦{食|た}べ{物|もの}→食べ物：02890_tabemono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{困|こま}らない→困る：00861_komaru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{願|ねが}い→願い：03529_negai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{込|こ}めて→込める：01945_komeru⟧⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{儀式|ぎしき}→儀式：00071_gishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: At the 100-day celebration, a symbolic first-meal ceremony is held with the wish that the baby will never lack food throughout life.

notes:
A milestone celebration for a baby at approximately 100 days old. The centerpiece is the ⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧ ceremony, where a symbolic meal is set before the baby (who does not actually eat it) to wish for a lifetime of abundance.

THE お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め CEREMONY:
- A tray of ceremonial foods is prepared, typically including ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧ (sea bream), ⟦{赤飯|せきはん}→赤飯：18955_sekihan⟧ (red rice), ⟦{煮物|にもの}→煮物：04971_nimono⟧ (simmered dish), ⟦{吸|す}い{物|もの}→吸い物：04990_suimono⟧ (clear soup), and {香|こう}の{物|もの} (pickles)
- {歯|は}{固|がた}め⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{石|いし}→石：02177_ishi⟧ — a small stone placed on the tray to wish for strong teeth
- The eldest family member pretends to feed the baby using chopsticks

ALTERNATIVE NAMES:
- ⟦お{食|く}い{初|ぞ}め→お食い初め：24466_okuizome⟧ — first-meal ceremony (the most commonly used name)
- {百日|ひゃくにち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧ — 100-day celebration (on'yomi reading)
